scenes.title: Welcome
scenes.line: Madison Park is moving to HomeownerHub. One easy place for your dues, your requests, and your news.
scenes.caption: Welcome to HomeownerHub

scenes.title: Step 1: Sign in
scenes.line: Open the invitation email from HomeownerHub, sent by your board, and tap the button. That signs you in. No password needed. Next time, tap Email me a link. Or choose a password.
scenes.caption: Step 1: Sign in

scenes.title: Step 2: Add it to your phone
scenes.line: Add it to your home screen, so it opens like any app. On iPhone, use Safari. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use Chrome. Tap the menu. Then tap Add to Home screen, or Install app.
scenes.caption: Step 2: Add it to your phone

scenes.title: Dues and statement
scenes.line: Tap Dues to see what you owe, and your statement. Tap Pay to see how your board takes payment.
scenes.caption: Dues and statement

scenes.title: Ask the board
scenes.line: Need something fixed? Tap Requests, then New support request. Write a note, and tap Send request.
scenes.caption: Ask the board

scenes.title: Book a space
scenes.line: To book the clubhouse or the pool, tap Community, then Book a space. Pick a space, a day, and a time. Then check your booking, and tap Book it.
scenes.caption: Book a space

scenes.title: News and neighbors
scenes.line: On Home, you will find Announcements and Documents. Under Community, answer polls and talk with your neighbors.
scenes.caption: News and neighbors

scenes.title: If you get stuck
scenes.line: Stuck? Tap the Help button. It says Hello, and your first name. Or tap Ask, to chat with your assistant.
scenes.caption: If you get stuck

scenes.title: You are ready
scenes.line: Welcome to HomeownerHub, Madison Park. Your board is glad to help.
scenes.caption: You are ready
